configMaps.description: ConfigMaps rendered by the chart. Each entry creates a ConfigMap named exactly `name`, with no release prefix, so other applications can reference it. Mount it from `idp-advanced` with a `volumes` entry using a `configMap` source.

global.description: Included to allow the chart to be used as a subchart, as Helm injects .global from the top chart.

idp_aws_account.description: This value is set automatically by ArgoCD, but can be overridden here for local testing.

idp_oidc_provider_url.description: This value is set automatically by ArgoCD, but can be overridden here for local testing.
